name: Corvis Minor V
description: Corvis Minor V in the Corvis Minor system was a planet orbited by six moons, including Distna. It was a gray-orange gas giant located near an asteroid belt.
lead_paragraphs: Corvis Minor V in the Corvis Minor system was a planet orbited by six moons, including Distna. It was a gray-orange gas giant located near an asteroid belt.
